info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Cash Management Retrieval API enables users to access detailed trade banking information based on specified parameters. This API is primarily designed for businesses needing to retrieve cash management data related to trade transactions. Common consumers include financial institutions and corporate treasury departments that require insights on liquidity and trade financing. By specifying unique identifiers, users can efficiently obtain relevant banking details to support informed decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for cash management.
get.description: Fetch the detailed information of a specific cash management account identified by its unique ID, including balances, transactions, and account status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to cash management operations for the specific account identified by 'ACC-200045'. It takes parameters that define the context and specifics of the cash management data being requested.

GetTradeBankingByParam1Request.description: A string representation of the request body for the ACC-200045 operations in the cash management trade banking context.

facilityId.description: Identifier for the facility associated with the cash management operation.

counterpartyId.description: Identifier for the counterparty involved in the transaction.

amount.description: The amount related to the cash management operation, including value and currency.

maturityDate.description: The maturity date of the related financial operation.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record, indicating whether it's active, inactive, etc.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the record.

metadata.description: Metadata providing additional information about the response.

GetTradeBankingByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for cash management operations related to a specific account.

value.description: The numeric value of the amount.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

Amount.description: Represents the monetary amount consisting of value and currency.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp for when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing of the request occurred.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata about the response, such as IDs and timestamps.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This helps track the specific service in the banking system.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is executing the request. This assists in identifying the source of the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication via a JSON Web Token (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header when making requests to protected endpoints.
